featured_reviews.name: Vimal Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
The biggest issue is the deposit refund. The owner does not return the full deposit and creates unnecessary problems during the process. In my case, only around 60% of the deposit was returned, and the remaining amount was deducted without any clear or valid explanation. Charges were applied arbitrarily, which felt unfair.

I had to call more than 30 times just to get updates on my deposit, and many times the owner did not even pick up the calls. This made the whole process very frustrating and unprofessional.

Major suggestion: do not leave the PG until your full deposit is returned, as it becomes very difficult to recover the remaining amount later.

The PG had basic amenities and was manageable for staying, but there were several issues. Initially, there were problems with filtered water and the AC, which caused inconvenience. Although the owner fixed these after complaints, it took time and effort to get them resolved. Cleaning was done daily, which is a positive point, but there were still cockroaches in the kitchen, which was not hygienic.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Keshav
featured_reviews.review_text: Dhirubhai PG is not just about staying , it’s about living right. Prime Dadar location, excellent connectivity, clean and well-maintained rooms, peaceful surroundings, and a genuinely homely atmosphere that makes everyday life easier. The management is supportive, safety is well taken care of, and the overall vibe stays calm and respectful. People who live here understand the comfort, discipline, and convenience it offers. As for the haters , when a place does things right, noise is inevitable. Quality doesn’t argue, it simply exists. Those who know, know. ✨💯

Because of all these reasons, I left the PG. I would strongly not recommend this PG to any girl looking for a safe, calm, and respectful place to stay.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Ghatiya - My experience at Dhiru PG was absolutely terrible. The condition of the rooms was unacceptable, and the hygiene standards were shockingly poor. The worst part was the severe bedbug problem it was impossible to sleep peacefully at night. I was constantly disturbed, uncomfortable, and frustrated due to the lack of basic cleanliness and maintenance.
Despite this being a fundamental issue, there seemed to be no proper action taken to resolve it. A place meant for living should at the very least ensure a clean and safe sleeping environment, and this PG completely failed in that regard.
I would strongly caution anyone considering this PG to thoroughly inspect the rooms before committing. What I experienced was far below even the most basic expectations.

name: B.M.T.H. Lodge
description:
Next to restaurants and shops, this functional hostel is a 6-minute walk from Dadar railway station, and 2 km from Dadar Beach along Mahim Bay.
Utilitarian dorms feature bunk beds, TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi, along with fans and en suite bathrooms. Bed linens are provided.
There's a rooftop terrace with tables and chairs, as well as a communal lounge with a TV.

featured_reviews.name: Chinmoy Chakraborty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review date 19 Oct. 2023
Too much small room - all 1, 2, 3 beded. But 3 beded can be adjusted for additional 1 or 2 persons may be paying additional amount.
Morning tea, nasta (sira + uppma=50-50) is delivered by order to the attendents by paying high amount. But it would better as it is at 3rd floor, you will be tried to go and back to room for higher level.
Night food, drinks (soft & hard) can also be ordered by saying to the attendents. Secretly know that couples are allowed by showing valid ID proof. That's why any one may get refreshment by calling the "dirty" girls standing beside Dadar bridge or anywhere.[Please don't do so anyone].
Bathroom 3, urinal 2 and latrine 3 are common for all borders.
A western type and others are of Indian type. Not very clean as compared to * hotels. A bathroom is quite well finished with glazed tiles.
Sufficient hot water can be available from a common geyser point by holding in bucket as per requirement.
Hand shop and some type of powder is present at wash basin (2 + 2 nos) for hand wash.
TV works but no entertaining channel.
All beds are narrow. Most of them are domitory types.
Dormitory - ₹ 450/=
Single bed Non AC - ₹ 785/=
AC single - ₹ 1,800/= (costly compared to * hotels)
2 beded non AC ₹ 1,400/= (?)

This guest house at close proximity to Dadar Railway Station is the prime example of best use of the space available and utilise the common spaces.
